symbols.name: user_submits_password
symbols.description: A user has submitted a password for login

symbols.name: password_is_correct
symbols.description: The submitted password matches the account's stored password

symbols.name: password_is_incorrect
symbols.description: The submitted password does not match the account's stored password

symbols.name: access_granted
symbols.description: The system has granted the user access to the system

symbols.name: access_denied
symbols.description: The system has denied the user access to the system

symbols.name: failed_attempt_count
symbols.description: The total number of consecutive failed login attempts for the account

symbols.name: account_locked
symbols.description: The account is currently in a locked state

symbols.name: account_is_admin
symbols.description: The account has the administrator role

background.text: The failed attempt count cannot be negative.
Access cannot be both granted and denied.
A password cannot be both correct and incorrect.

rules.text: WHEN a user submits a correct password THEN the system grants access
rules.reading: If a user submits a password that is correct, the system must grant access to the user.

rules.text: WHEN a user submits an incorrect password THEN the system denies access
rules.reading: When a user submits a password that is incorrect, the system must deny access to that user.

rules.text: WHEN the number of failed attempts on an account reaches 5 THEN the system locks the account
rules.reading: If the number of consecutive failed login attempts on an account reaches 5, the system must lock that account.

alternative.reading: If the total number of consecutive failed login attempts for an account reaches 5, the account must be in a locked state.

rules.text: WHEN a user submits a password for a locked account THEN the system denies access
rules.reading: When a user attempts to log in to an account that is currently locked, the system must deny access.

rules.text: WHEN the account belongs to an administrator THEN the system does not lock the account
rules.reading: If the account has the administrator role, the system must not be in a locked state.
